data.completion_memo: Implemented core-only opaque credential references and single-use, host-generation audience-bound, expiring/revocable secret leases. Values never enter canonical DTOs. cargo check -p aworkit-trusted-core passes.
data.description: Implement the core-only secret broker, PlatformCredentialStorePort, and hermetic credential-store conformance adapter with opaque references, audience-bound short-lived leases, single-purpose redemption, expiry, revocation, and zeroization. Secret values must never enter canonical or portable data. Native Windows, macOS, and Linux credential stores are owned by M12.3.
data.title: M05.6 — Implement credential references and invocation-scoped secret leases
